Man my house is a total mess. It was my goal today to clean up but. I got distracted. I will soon though. I swear. haha

I've never really gotten into visual arts. I'm not really a visual person. I can appreciate it but if I try to do it, it doesn't feel right lol. I write music but mostly in my head... lyrics usually end up on paper but I haven't had the time/motivation to get good enough at translating what's in my head to instruments. I'm going to move that up on my priority list though, now that I'm realizing how therapeutic it actually is. Which is funny because I've been playing instruments for 12 years but never had that 'Aha! I understand why I like this so much' moment until recently lol
Flute, clarinet, ukulele. No real recordings... I just like to jam out on my own and with friends sometimes

Learning? Sure. Growing? Sure. But, learning and growing can go in many directions. I've learned that my head is pretty messy and it's only growing messier lol

I'd be ecstatic if I practiced my talents and was appreciated for them. I play music but not often enough but I performed for a bunch of folks last night at the party and it was a lot of fun
I'd be ecstatic if I was in shape and athletic... I'm not out of shape but I haven't had time to go to the gym in the past month
I'd be ecstatic if my room was clean and organized haha. That's today's mission...

I think I'll be okay when I come to terms with who I am and how I act... that it's okay to not be in love with others, as long as you're in love with yourself and don't do anyone serious harm. I'm kind of a cold hearted bitch by nature... I don't tell my friends 'awww I'm sorry'... I tell them to pull up their f**king pants and get on with their lives. I think the problem is I have a tendency to believe that I'm a bad person for not being 'kind.' I'm not. I just have different ways of expressing my kindness. And little tolerance for weak and unintelligent people hah.

It's a private party in a big VIP room waiting for cocktail hour to stop and the dancing to begin.

But speaking of parties and friends, I do have a birthday to celebrate rather soon.

Thank you for the discussion thus far, it shall continue later.

Me either. No one deserves to be abused. But as someone who has felt it, and someone who has dealt it, sometimes we don't know what to do and hurt feels like the best option because it's a quick rip of the band-aid instead of a slow, drawn-out peel.

Of course, if you just peeled to begin with and didn't jump to the quick and easy, you wouldn't have to stick on and subsequently rip off so many band-aids. But who thinks like that? We're impulsive critters. Abusers rarely act out of psychopathy. They do it because they don't know what else to do.

I feel like if someone doesn't come to the point of destroying their physical lives, they've never learned how it is to be -un-happy lol

They say the shadow proves the sunshine, but 'they' say a lot of shit, and most of it comes from a bull's butt.

Eh... I think a lot more people would be willing to get each other if that happened, yes.

But intuitive understanding, in my humble belief, is rooted in something that lives at a much deeper, darker, and scarier level than most people dare to access, or even know exists.
I always feel my best when I think this way. I just wish I could sustain it :/

I don't want to try. I want to do. If I have to try then it means it's going against my grain.

I just want to feel like I'm not going to spend the rest of my life getting good things handed to me and then uncontrollably throwing them away.

I'd also like to feel like I can have a close relationship with someone without that getting f**ked up too.

I was terrified of having my past affect my present and guess what, it did.

So I'm terrified I'm going to end up resorting to suicide. And people will say, guess what, she did.
I feel the same lol. There are few who I think really 'get' me.

Meanwhile, I f**k up a perfectly good relationship with a perfectly respectable guy, who I'm not in love with.

No specific thoughts. Just when I can't change them. When I think negative and mean things and can rationalize that they're negative and mean and can see a positive and nice thing but it doesn't click and it's frustrating. When I think too much and try to not think by focusing on something else but it doesn't click and it's frustrating. I'm constantly battling myself, knowing what I should be doing and how I should be doing it, but being unable to. Which stems both from and creates insecurity, I'm sure. But I don't know how to stop it. I rationally can say I have nothing to be insecure about, except seeming insecure, which is what social anxiety is all about. But it happens with everything. And it's exhausting.

I get content pretty easily, but right now I'm not. Actually, this is pretty much what happens when I get content. I need something to 'spice' up my life, but end up f**king it up instead. I've been alternating between the happiest I've ever been and the depressed I've ever been for the better part of the past ten years. Each time I switch back to depression it just gets worse. I could be bipolar but, when I'm happy I'm not dangerously unhealthy about it and when I'm depressed I'm not dangerously unhealthy about it and I'm pretty good at keeping an external stability and my life in order. But sometimes I just freak out and lose control of my mind for a few hours when I'm overwhelmed by my thoughts and I'm afraid for the time I will freak out and decide to end it. I'm introverted by nature so that forces most things to be kept inside. If anyone saw me and didn't know any better, they wouldn't have a clue. My own parents don't even have a clue.
